# Codebase Facts — Chassis React Migration

Reference sheet for AI agents. Verified against codebase on 2026-05-12.

## Repository Root

```
/Volumes/Ozgur/Dropbox/Sites/chassis-react
```

## Package Structure

| Package | Name | Purpose |
|---------|------|---------|
| `packages/react` | `@chassis-ui/react` | Component library (the product) |
| `packages/docs` | `@chassis-ui/react-docs` | OLD Gatsby docs — delete in Phase 3 |
| `packages/site` | `@chassis-ui/react-site` | NEW Astro docs — create in Phase 3 |

## `packages/react` — Library Facts

- **React version**: 17 → target 18
- **TypeScript**: 4 → target 5
- **Bundler**: Rollup 2 (→ 4)
- **Test runner**: Jest 27 + ts-jest + @testing-library/react 12
- **Component count**: 30 component directories, 90+ individual exports
- **All components**: functional, hooks-based, `forwardRef` — no class components
- **Deprecated React APIs in source**: NONE (zero deprecated lifecycle methods, no string refs, no `findDOMNode`)
- **`prop-types`**: imported in ~90 source files — redundant (full TS interfaces exist), remove in Phase 1
- **`react-popper`**: used by `CxTooltip`, `CxDropdown`, `CxPopover` — v2, React 18 compatible
- **`react-transition-group`**: v4, React 18 compatible
- **Portals**: used by `CxModal` (`createPortal` from `react-dom`) — fine in React 18

### Test files with legacy patterns

| File | Issue | Fix |
|------|-------|-----|
| `src/components/tooltip/__tests__/CxTooltip.spec.tsx` | `ReactDOM.render()` (2 calls) | Replace with `createRoot()` |

### Component entry point
`src/index.ts` — re-exports all `Cx*` components

### Shared utilities
- `src/components/Types.tsx` — `Colors`, `Shapes`, `Triggers`, `Placements` union types + PropTypes
- `src/utils/hooks.ts` — `useForkedRef` and other shared hooks

## `packages/docs` — Old Gatsby Docs (to be deleted)

- **Framework**: Gatsby 3 + MDX v1
- **Content location**: `content/1.0/` (sections: `components/`, `forms/`, `getting-started/`, `layout/`, `patterns/`)
- **Component MDX count**: 25 files in `components/`
- **MDX globals** (Gatsby-injected, no explicit import): `<Example>`, `<Callout>`
- **API docs**: generated by `react-docgen-typescript` in a Gatsby Node.js step (`gatsby-node.js`)
- **Target URL**: was `chassis-ui.io/react/` (legacy) → new is `chassis-ui.com/react/`

### MDX frontmatter shape (current, Gatsby)
```yaml
---
title: Buttons Component
name: Bootstrap React Buttons
description: ...
menu: Components
route: /components/buttons
---
```

### MDX frontmatter shape (target, Astro docsSchema)
```yaml
---
title: Button
description: ...
added:
  version: "1.0"
toc: true
---
```

## chassis-website — Astro Patterns to Follow

### Key config files
- `packages/website/astro.config.ts` — full config with `chassis()` integration
- `packages/website/src/content.config.ts` — Zod schemas for `docsSchema`
- `packages/website/src/libs/astro.ts` — `chassis()` Astro integration
- `packages/website/src/libs/config.ts` — `getConfig()` (site/env config)
- `packages/website/src/pages/docs/[...slug].astro` — docs page with sidebar, TOC

### `docsSchema` fields (from content.config.ts)
`title`, `description`, `added.version`, `added.show_badge`, `aliases`, `direction`, `extra_js`, `sections`, `thumbnail`, `toc`

### Astro integration stack (chassis-website)
- `@astrojs/react` — NOT used (chassis-website is CSS-only)
- `@chassis-ui/docs` — shared doc utilities (rehype plugins, getSiteUrl, etc.)
- `chassis()` — custom Astro integration (code blocks, nav generation, etc.)
- Prism — syntax highlighting
- Algolia — search
- SCSS with silenced deprecations (Bootstrap/Sass compatibility flags)

### React-specific additions needed in `packages/site`
- `@astrojs/react` integration (for React islands)
- `client:visible` or `client:load` directives on `<ReactExample>`
- `react` + `react-dom` as dev deps in the Astro package

## Dependency Graph

```
packages/site (Astro)
  ├── @chassis-ui/react (local workspace link)
  ├── @chassis-ui/css (link:../../../chassis-css)
  ├── @chassis-ui/tokens (link:../../../chassis-tokens)
  ├── @chassis-ui/docs (npm package)
  └── astro + @astrojs/react + ...

packages/react (library)
  ├── @chassis-ui/tokens (link:../../../chassis-tokens) [build dep only]
  └── react, react-dom [peer deps]
```

## Monorepo Tooling (current → target)

| Tool | Current | Target |
|------|---------|--------|
| Package manager | Yarn + workspaces | pnpm + workspaces |
| Orchestrator | Lerna 4 | pnpm `--filter` |
| Lock file | `yarn.lock` | `pnpm-lock.yaml` |
| Workspace config | `"workspaces"` in root `package.json` | `pnpm-workspace.yaml` |

### Current root scripts (Lerna) → target equivalents
| Current | Target |
|---------|--------|
| `lerna run --scope "@chassis-ui/react-docs" develop` | `pnpm --filter @chassis-ui/react-site dev` |
| `lerna run --scope "@chassis-ui/react-docs" build` | `pnpm --filter @chassis-ui/react-site build` |
| `lerna run --scope "@chassis-ui/react" build` | `pnpm --filter @chassis-ui/react build` |
